intrigue_scheme_ongoing.5005 = {
	id_override_priority = 10 # AC: individual CK3 1.20.1 event override

	type = character_event

	left_portrait = {

	}

		character = scope:spymaster
		animation = bribing
	}
	lower_left_portrait = scope:target
	widget = {
		gui = "event_window_widget_scheme"
		container = "custom_widgets_container"
	}

	trigger = {
		is_available_adult = yes
		gold > root.minor_gold_value
		scope:scheme = {
			NOT = { has_variable = had_poisonous_gold_event }
			scheme_agent_charges < opportunity_cap_value
		}
		OR = {
			cp:councillor_spymaster ?= {
				this != scope:target
			}
			any_court_position_holder = {
				type = second_camp_officer
				this != scope:target
			}
		}
		scope:target = {
			is_physically_able_adult = yes
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		scope:scheme = {
			set_variable = {
				name = had_poisonous_gold_event
				value = yes
				days = 3650
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_court_position_holder = {
					type = second_camp_officer
					this != scope:target
				}
			}
			random_court_position_holder = {
				type = second_camp_officer
				save_scope_as = spymaster
			}
		}
		cp:councillor_spymaster ?= {
			save_scope_as = spymaster
		}
	}

	# Give them poisonous gold
	option = { # AC: ac_event_refined_poison_gift
		name = ac_event_refined_poison_gift
		reason = cultivation
		trigger = { ac_event_poison_gift_trigger = yes  }
		custom_tooltip = ac_event_poison_gift_tt
		save_scope_as = ac_event_practitioner
		save_scope_as = owner
		pay_short_term_gold = { target = scope:target gold = root.minor_gold_value }
		scope:scheme = { change_opportunities = 2 }
		scope:target = { trigger_event = intrigue_scheme_ongoing.5006 }
		scope:ac_event_practitioner = { ac_event_exertion_effect = yes }
		ai_chance = { base = 200 }
	}

	option = {
		name = intrigue_scheme_ongoing.5005.a
		pay_short_term_gold = { #Give them their gift...
			target = scope:target
			gold = root.minor_gold_value
		}
		show_as_tooltip = { #Actually add it in their response event
			scope:target = {
				add_character_modifier = {
					modifier = poisonous_gold_modifier
					years = 7
				}
			}
		}
		scope:scheme = {
			change_opportunities = 2
